bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
cd "$root"
log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-shared-menu-smoke.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
PYTHONPATH=scripts timeout 72s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu >"$log" 2>&1 || true
grep -E '^USERBOT_TEST_(RESULT|ERROR|MENU_ROWS|ACTION)=' "$log" || true
if grep -q '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS$' "$log" && grep -q '^USERBOT_TEST_MENU_ROWS=3,2,2,3,1$' "$log"; then
 echo LIVE_MENU_CHECK=PASS
 exit 0
fi
if grep -q '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=FAIL$' "$log"; then echo LIVE_MENU_CHECK=FAILED_RESPONSE; exit 71; fi
echo LIVE_MENU_CHECK=IPC_OR_CONNECTION_UNVERIFIED
exit 72
